issues.legal_issue: A court-ordered partition that assigns land already notified as surplus is an invalid disposition when made after the notification, even though the land has not yet vested in the State through taking possession.
material_facts: The land was held as part of a joint family and was included in a return filed under the agricultural land ceiling scheme.
The authority determined the surplus land, and a notification identifying it was published before the partition decree was passed.
The decree assigned land identified as surplus to a family member and directed that agricultural land be partitioned and separate possession delivered through the revenue authority.
The family member later claimed the land under the decree, but the authorities rejected the claim.
issues.conclusion: The decree could not confer an effective right to the notified surplus land. A disposition made in execution of the decree was invalid, and the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 21(2) of the unamended Maharashtra Agricultural Lands (Ceiling on Holdings) Act, after publication of the notification identifying surplus land, any disposition of that land, including a transfer in execution of a court decree or order, is invalid and of no effect. The provision is not limited to partitions made by parties during their lifetimes, as are Sections 8 and 9. A partition decree concerning land assessed to government revenue is executed through the Collector under Section 54 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, and Order XX, Rule 18(1); accordingly, partition and delivery of possession under such a decree are a disposition within Section 21(2). The fact that the surplus land vests in the State only when possession is taken under Section 21(4) does not validate a disposition prohibited after notification. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: agricultural_ceiling_surplus_dispute and surplus_land_officially_notified and partition_decree_after_notification and decree_assigns_notified_surplus_land and decree_execution_involves_partition_or_possession

predicates.agricultural_ceiling_surplus_dispute: The proceeding concerned land identified as excess under an agricultural land ceiling scheme.
predicates.surplus_land_officially_notified: An authority officially notified that the land was surplus.
predicates.partition_decree_after_notification: A court issued the partition decree after the surplus-land notification was published.
predicates.decree_assigns_notified_surplus_land: The decree assigned land covered by the surplus-land notification to a person.
predicates.decree_execution_involves_partition_or_p: Execution of the decree involved partitioning the land or delivering separate possession of it.

issues.definition: When a ceiling-land proceeding involves officially notified surplus land assigned by a later partition decree whose execution partitions the land or delivers possession, the disposition of that land is invalid.
